overview: A purchase option in a lease is a clause allowing the lessee to buy the leased asset (equipment or property) during or at the end of the term. It offers flexibility and potential ownership without immediate full capital expenditure, often featuring a pre-set fixed price or fair market value (FMV) at lease end.
